summary: Jason Brooks, 50, of Wheat Ridge took a ~100-foot tumbling fall onto soft snow while solo climbing near Black Lake; SPOT activation at 12:30 p.m., rangers reached him in about 2.5 hours and Flight for Life flew him to Medical Center of the Rockies
location: Black Lake, Glacier Gorge, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue, Larimer County Search and Rescue, Rocky Mountain Rescue
notes: Fall witnessed by visitors at Black Lake; Brooks was ambulatory after the fall
